newsitem.title: HONDURAS: SOCCER-HONDURAS BEAT ST VINCENT 11-3 IN WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-HONDURAS BEAT ST VINCENT 11-3 IN WORLD CUP QUALIFIER.

text.p: Honduras beat St Vincent 11-3 (halftime 5-1) in a CONCACAF semifinal stage group three World Cup qualifying match on Sunday.

Honduras - Basilio Zapata (3rd), Nicolas Suazo (11th, 30th and 50th), Arnaldo Cruz (19th), Nerlin Membreno (38th), Milton Nunez (49th, 70th and 88th), Eduardo Bennet (65th), Enrique Centeno Renau (77th),
St Vincent - Aldwin Gay (37th and 57th), Christopher Harris (75th).
